description.value: Copper Point Resort is Invermere's premier upscale destination in the Columbia Valley, offering accommodations ranging from standard queen rooms to two-bedroom loft suites. The resort serves as a four-season base with access to golf, skiing at nearby Kootenay Rockies resorts, and outdoor adventures — making it a comfortable stopping point for touring cyclists on routes through the Columbia Valley. On-site dining, a spa, and full event facilities give it a full-service resort character.
